purpose: Acquire the official NOAA/NCEI daily weather lineage for the Palomar Mountain Observatory area and quantify element/date completeness before using local weather as an acquisition/visibility covariate.

authority.dataset: NOAA/NCEI Global Historical Climatology Network Daily (GHCN-Daily)
authority.historical_name_target: PALOMAR MTN OBSERVATORY / PALOMAR MOUNTAIN OBSERVATORY
authority.supporting_coop_inventory_hint: COOP 046657-6 is associated with Palomar Mtn Observatory in the historical California station inventory; the GHCN station identifier must be resolved from the official NCEI station inventory rather than assumed.

source_only_tasks: Resolve all official GHCN station rows whose names contain PALOMAR and rank by distance to Palomar Schmidt coordinates.
Select the closest historically appropriate station only if its official record overlaps the study window.
Freeze station-inventory bytes and selected station-file bytes by SHA-256.
Report daily coverage for each available element (including PRCP, TMAX, TMIN when present) without joining POSS-I or Blue Book.
Preserve GHCN measurement, quality and source flags; a value failing quality control is not silently admitted.

initial_weather_roles.PRCP: acquisition/visibility proxy; precipitation may affect whether plates were taken and plate quality
initial_weather_roles.TMAX_TMIN: environment/acquisition covariates; not direct cloud measurements

hard_boundaries: Daily precipitation is not cloud cover and may not be interpreted as clear-sky fraction.
A missing GHCN row or flagged value is not zero precipitation or normal weather.
Weather cannot be said to explain any POSS-I pattern before an outcome-blind coverage gate and a preregistered conditional-on-observation model.
Do not use weather to reclassify unobserved Palomar calendar days as observed zeros.
No Blue Book local-weather inference is permitted from a Palomar station; witness-local weather is a separate future problem.
admission_next: If the selected station has adequate element coverage, freeze a JPFM-5B weather-adjusted POSS model before inspecting coefficients. The primary unit remains an actually observed Palomar night.
